title: Completed integral quotient models for rational finite stratum filtrations
statement: Let l be prime, E/Q_l finite, and X a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme with l stalkwise invertible. Let s be the raw normalized rational module realization [lem-per-rational-module-realization-functor]. For every module F over the continuous rational coefficient sheaf that is finite locally free after site inverse image on each stratum of a finite locally closed stratification, there is a finite filtration of F by monomorphisms with zero first term and final term F. Every successive quotient is the realization of a degree-zero object of the published completed integral constructible category. More precisely these data form RationalConeModels.Filtration [lem-per-rational-realization-finite-cone-models], with the original filtration maps and a specified integral realization isomorphism for each quotient.

proof.text: Transport F to the WithAbs continuous coefficient presentation. The finite free criterion gives continuous constructibility, so the rational stratum integral-model theorem supplies a finite filtration and the normalized integral lattice models of its quotients.

For each integral piece N use its completed-model certificate b and take the explicit degree-zero complex of restriction of N along b.hom. Its given membership proof places this object in the published completed constructible category. The finite normalization of s determines each finiteIso uniquely by the constant-sheaf universal property. Comparison of all finite projections then identifies b.inv followed by s.integralIso.hom with the pointwise integral coefficient encoding. The normalized inclusion gives the ordinary scalar square. Uniqueness of left adjoints supplies the ordinary scalar-extension comparison; no arbitrary derived essential-image witness is used.

Transport every term and arrow of the supplied filtration along inverse coefficient restriction. The restriction round trip gives the final identification with F; exactness preserves zero objects, monomorphisms and cokernels. Uniqueness of the left-derived functor identifies the exact scalar-extension functor with its induced derived functor, and Mathlib mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor identifies its value on the explicit single complex. Compose s.objects, this comparison, the ordinary scalar square, the supplied beta quotient isomorphism and the preserved cokernel isomorphism. These maps give every Filtration field, including length zero.

proof_origin.place: K7 complete Lean assembly of the given stratum filtration, normalized finite/completed scalar square, exact derived-single comparison and preservation of cokernels in BS 6.8.14(2).

lean.statement:
theorem rationalContinuousFiltrationModels (X : Base.{u} l)
    (s : RationalModuleRealization l E X.scheme)
    (F : pbcModules X.scheme (rationalCoefficientSheaf l X.scheme E))
    (hF : ∃ t : FiniteLocallyClosedStratification X.scheme, ∀ i : Fin t.n,
      ((proEtaleModuleInverseImage (t.immersion i)
        (rationalCoefficientSheaf l X.scheme E)).obj F).IsFiniteLocallyFree) :
    Nonempty (RationalConeModels.Filtration l E X.scheme s F)
